hold_reason_meanings.FILENAME_EVENT_WITHOUT_EXACT_TOURNAMENT_: Event is a filename or shorthand requiring individual context resolution; no whole-raw inference.
hold_reason_meanings.COMPACT_EVENT_TITLE_NOT_ADJUDICATED: Compact Latin title or encoded shorthand has not received a dedicated event-context adjudication in this conservative tranche. Some are genuine ordinary professional tournament titles; this is uncertainty, not a finding that the event or player is invalid.
hold_reason_meanings.EXHIBITION_AMATEUR_OR_SPECIAL_CONTEXT_RE: Invitation, exchange, teaching, amateur or other special context needs a dated match/career anchor before linkage.
hold_reason_meanings.RANK_OUTSIDE_FEDERATION_CHRONOLOGY: Recorded numeric rank conflicts with official dated/period-specific promotion history. Source metadata could be stale; no second identity is inferred.
hold_reason_meanings.ADMISSION_INTERVAL_WITHOUT_EXACT_DATE: Game falls inside a year/month-only pro admission interval; precise admission or game anchor was not established.
hold_reason_meanings.SPECIAL_MATCH_CONTEXT_NOT_INDEPENDENTLY_: Training, grinding/practice, blindfold, informal team/ladder or similar special match lacks a dedicated anchor.
hold_reason_meanings.JANUARY_FIRST_UNRESOLVED_DATE_PRECISION: January 1 may be an unknown-date placeholder; no exact game date is inferred.
hold_reason_meanings.EVENT_METADATA_UNRESOLVED: Explicit event year/phase/series inconsistency or insufficient event description is recorded in the per-slot note.
hold_reason_meanings.NONSTANDARD_OPPONENT_RANK_REQUIRES_REVIE: Opponent rank is an amateur/pin/title/free-text value. Some title labels are valid; this conservative tranche does not infer or rewrite them.
hold_reason_meanings.MISSING_EVENT_CONTEXT: Event is absent; identity is not inferred from name alone.
hold_reason_meanings.MALFORMED_OPPONENT_NAME: Opponent string contains private-use or escape artifacts; dedicated context review required.
hold_reason_meanings.PRE_PROFESSIONAL_RECORD_NEEDS_DISTINCT_A: Date precedes the official pro admission; needs an amateur or historical match anchor.
hold_reason_meanings.DATE_BEFORE_BIRTH: Date precedes the official birth and cannot be used as coherent career evidence.
hold_reason_meanings.NONSTANDARD_OR_AMATEUR_RANK: Own rank has corrupt or unrecognized text, or is not a professional numeric rank.
hold_reason_meanings.COMPUTER_OR_MIXED_OPPONENT: Opponent string identifies or combines a computer/mixed participant; standard person-vs-person linkage is not inferred.
hold_reason_meanings.EXTERNAL_RESULT_CONFLICT: Frozen SGF/result conflicts with the dated contextual archive. Exact record 75293 remains HOLD; no result correction authorized.

definitions.PROMOTION_INTERVAL_ADJACENT_RANK: Official promotion precision is year/month/day; both ranks on either side of that interval can be valid. Exception is fixed per slot, not a broad rank waiver.
definitions.D_SUFFIX_ACCEPTED_ONLY_WITH_COHERENT_PRO: Historical d notation is accepted only in an otherwise coherent federation-anchored professional record; no rank field is converted.
definitions.EXPLICIT_TAIWAN_OR_CHINESE_TAIPEI_SELECT: The literal title identifies Taiwan/Chinese Taipei selection; the China substring is not misread as mainland domestic selection.
definitions.EMPTY_FIRST_SO_WITH_EXACT_19X19_ASSOCIAT: Only albums 497,602,1348: row source is NULL and first SGF SO is empty; second SO is https://19x19.com and the exact source_id/source_path association establishes provenance.
definitions.DATED_EXTERNAL_MATCH_CONTEXT: Only 73249 and 106142: CWI 1990 exchange index independently matches date, both players, result and move count; federation profiles remain identity authority.

checks.duplicate_scope: All 7168 albums in the supplied new33 capture; exact SGF bytes and exact mainline coordinate sequence. No full-database, rotated-board or prefix-duplicate completeness claim.

execution_constraints: Only the fixed approved_slots (album_id, side, raw) tuples may change their own player FK from NULL; never UPDATE by raw name alone.

Create at most one row per each of the 16 explicit Chinese canonicals, only after fresh global players/aliases/names zero-owner checks and complete catalog preimage reconciliation. Any new owner hit requires revised target review, not duplicate insertion.
No alias, localized name, translation, staging status, SGF, raw text, rank, date, event, source, search text, duplicate marker, opposite FK or event edition mutation is authorized by this decision.

Preserve the firstbatch 1451 prior approvals, 155 firstbatch context HOLDs, 2469 prior identity HOLDs, this batch 543 HOLDs and every unrelated earlier HOLD. Other six languages keep the existing English fallback policy; translation has not started.

Execution needs a fresh full read-only snapshot and SHA-pinned per-environment plan. Original frozen row hashes remain historical evidence; apply only after every exact committed firstbatch/next514/next3 delta and actual catalog row is reconciled.
Never omit event_id, black_player_id, white_player_id, created_at, SGF, source, aliases, names, staging or any guarded field to tolerate drift. Unexpected changes require another exact rebase.
Assert approved member/target digests, exact update/new-player counts and postimages; on mismatch fail the transaction. No partial raw-resolution status may be written.
inference_limits: All remaining 3298 slots were screened individually, and each has an explicit approved/HOLD decision. Approval is conservative; 543 unresolved contexts remain HOLD, including 95 compact Latin event titles not given a dedicated tournament adjudication.

Federation profiles establish each person and career chronology; the frozen 19x19 SGF/source trail supplies ordinary-game context. Dedicated external federation match lookup for every clean game is not claimed.
Promotion source precision is retained rather than inventing exact dates. Missing rank is not populated; rank conflicts may be old source metadata but remain HOLD.
The three source-null rows retain all source metadata. Two independently anchored 1990 exchange records are approved; 75293 remains HOLD because CWI lists the opposite winner.
Opponent owner variants are recorded by full catalog hashes but not approved or corrected by this task.
No direct database access, writes, production application or code changes were performed by this reviewer. Artifacts and source captures are the only repository additions.
